Definition: a Temanite or descendant of Teman
BiblicalUsage: A Temanite is a descendant of Teman, from the Edomite region of Teman. In Genesis 36:34, Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead. The fuller story is told on the Teman profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that the Temanite is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
